| # RC27-18/40 - Closed loop parameters for valves {#rc27-1840---closed-loop-parameters-for-valves-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                              |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

To make it easier to control Rexroth valves and solenoids the following table shows recommended parameter values for the output configuration functions.

 

The parameter values are valid for following outputs:

  Output Cluster   Pins                                          BODAS Controller
  ---------------- --------------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Cluster 1        K07, K08, K09, K29, K73, K17, K14, K15, K16   [RC18-12/40](hw-ml-outputs.html){.topiclink} and [RC27-18/40](hw-ml-outputs.html){.topiclink}
  Cluster 2        A31, A32, A33, A46, A47, A48, A05, A19, A20   [RC18-12/40](hw-ml-outputs.html){.topiclink} and [RC27-18/40](hw-ml-outputs.html){.topiclink}
  Cluster 3        A34, A35, A51, A52, A53, A54, A02, A09, A17   [RC27-18/40](hw-ml-outputs.html){.topiclink}

 

 

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Notice_RGB 39-153-209](hmfile_hash_c5013a84.png){style="margin:0;width:1.4792in;height:0.2813in;border:none"}   The recommended values are the starting values for the optimization process and these values need to be checked for each individual application.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
